table.retrieve:
SELECT
	DSTBIDLEN=6,
	DSTBID=:as_dstcode + REPLICATE(' ', 6 - LEN(:as_dstcode)),
	CUSTIDLEN=10,
	CUSTID = SUBSTRING(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(C.CustCode, 10))), 1, 10),
	CUSTNAMELEN=50,
	CUSTNAME = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(A.Name, 1, 50))) + REPLICATE(' ', 50 - LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(A.Name, 1, 50))))),
	ADDRESSLEN=50,
	ADDRESS = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(C.ADDRESS1, 1, 50))) + REPLICATE(' ', 50 - LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(C.ADDRESS1, 1, 50))))),
	CTLEN=2,
	CT=CASE 
		WHEN LEFT((SELECT CT.NAME FROM CUSTOMERCATEGORY CT WHERE CT.CUSTCATCODE = C.CUSTCATCODE), 1) = 'W' THEN '01'
		WHEN LEFT((SELECT CT.NAME FROM CUSTOMERCATEGORY CT WHERE CT.CUSTCATCODE = C.CUSTCATCODE), 1) = 'R' THEN '02'
		WHEN LEFT((SELECT CT.NAME FROM CUSTOMERCATEGORY CT WHERE CT.CUSTCATCODE = C.CUSTCATCODE), 1) = 'I' THEN '03'
		WHEN LEFT((SELECT CT.NAME FROM CUSTOMERCATEGORY CT WHERE CT.CUSTCATCODE = C.CUSTCATCODE), 1) = 'D' THEN '04'
		ELSE '02' END,
	CityLen = 60,
	City = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(C.City, 1, 50))),
	TOWNIDLEN=16,
	TOWNID= SUBSTRING(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(AR.AREACODE, 16))), 1, 16), 
	TOWNLEN=50,
	TOWN = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(AR.NAME, 1, 50))) + REPLICATE(' ', 50 - LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(AR.NAME, 1, 50))))),
	PTCLNoLen = 12,
	PTCLNo = SUBSTRING(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.PHONE)), 1, 12), 
	MobileNo1Len = 12,
	MobileNo1 = SUBSTRING(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.CellNo)), 1, 12), 
	MobileNo2Len = 12,
	MobileNo2 = SUBSTRING(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.OffPhone)), 1, 12), 
	EmailLen = 50,
	Email = SUBSTRING(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.Email)), 1, 50), 
	ContactPerconLen = 50,
	ContactPercon = SUBSTRING(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.CP)), 1, 50), 
	StatusLen = 1,
	Status = A.Active,
	LastInvDateLen=10,
	LastInvDate = Convert(varchar(10), ISNULL((SELECT MAX(S.Date) FROM SaleLedger S WHERE S.CustCode=C.CustCode), GETDATE()), 103),
	LicenceNoLen = 30,
	LicenceNo = SUBSTRING(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.LicenceNo)), 1, 50)
FROM Customer C, Accounts A, Area AR
WHERE C.CustCode = A.AccCode AND C.AreaCode = AR.AreaCode
